principles: Public Lattice CLI consumes Authority credentials; it does not mint server-owned bundles.
Preserve existing authority config parsing and receipt/gate behavior unless directly tied to generation cleanup.
Documentation must make the operator/developer handoff clear without exposing private server internals.
Tests should guard against generator reintroduction rather than chasing unrelated optimizations.
drivers: The CLI is intended to be open source.
Developers need a simple file-based handoff.
Server-side Python generation is being implemented in a separate private repo.
Existing live runner and receipt flows depend on env consumption staying stable.

options.name: A: Remove/de-scope CLI generation and adjust tests/docs to consumer-only
pros: Makes accidental senior bundle generation visible in tests/search
cons: Requires updating smoke tests that previously used the generator helper

options.name: B: Keep generator helper as an internal test utility only
cons: Leaves public source with server-owned generation semantics and invites accidental reuse

options.name: C: Port the server Python generator into CLI as a hidden command
cons: Directly violates the private-server credential boundary and open-source split

chosen: A: Remove/de-scope CLI generation and adjust tests/docs to consumer-only
rationale: Option A is the smallest correctness fix that makes the public CLI boundary true: CLI tests can still create fixture env files manually, but no reusable CLI generator should remain.

preMortem.trigger: Shared constants or parser code are removed along with the generator
preMortem.consequence: Server-provided files stop working in authority status or receipt paths
preMortem.mitigation: Keep filename constants and parser/read logic; update focused smoke tests for consumer-only fixtures

preMortem.scenario: Docs still tell users to generate bundles locally
preMortem.trigger: Only code is changed and public docs are missed
preMortem.consequence: Developers follow an impossible or insecure workflow after open source release
preMortem.mitigation: Search docs for generation wording and replace it with server/operator-provided file handoff

preMortem.scenario: Senior generation survives through a smoke helper
preMortem.trigger: Tests retain buildAuthorityTrustProfileBundle or equivalent hidden writer
preMortem.consequence: The public repo still demonstrates minting senior files
preMortem.mitigation: Search source/tests for generator names and add assertions/search evidence in checklist verification
